mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. Imagine a place where wit and irreverence go hand in hand, where language gets twisted, and the absurdities of daily life are put under a microscope—sometimes leaving you laughing, and other times, leaving you thinking a little deeper. That's the world George Carlin invites us into. As we journey together through Last Words, co-authored by the legendary Carlin himself, you'll find that he never held back from questioning authority or poking holes in the things most people just accept without a second thought. He makes us laugh, sure, but his comedy is also a kind of armor—a way to push back at chaos and see the truth hiding beneath the surface. Get ready for stories that move from smoky, underground comedy clubs all the way to the glitz of mainstream fame. In every tale, you’ll hear Carlin’s relentless drive to tell it like it is—even when it’s uncomfortable, even when it means being vulnerable or defiant. We’re not just here for a few laughs. Through Carlin’s eyes, we get to question what we take for granted, spot the little hypocrisies that shape our world, and maybe even see ourselves a bit more clearly. So, let’s step into this journey together. There’s a lot to discover—and who knows? You might just come away looking at life with a whole new sense of humor.
